goal: flywheel status lists an unresolved landing strand with its park kind even when the run's task file is absent from the active listing, and only a resolution marker -- never archival or a task-file move -- clears it from the view.

graders.name: behavior

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- _cmd_status (~1437-1606) assembles the two stranded record surfaces; _landing_park_for_run (~1377) is only consulted for rows in the active listing (the limit criterion 6 removes); _stop_events_by_subject (~1395) is the store-backed read to build on; use serena symbols

references: .flywheel/specs/00077-FEATURE-phase-archival-integrity.md -- criterion 6; scope note: the strand surface is the existing status stranded view with its source changed, not a new screen
constraints: The strand renders with its park kind on BOTH the text and --json status surfaces, keyed by subject, when no task row exists for it in the active listing
Only a resolution marker (probe- or operator-attributed) clears the strand from the view; archiving the phase or moving/deleting the task file must not

All stranded/stop reads route through build_claim_store (no direct sqlite claim-store construction on a read path -- the d63cf3e contract test_status_distributed.py pins); test with the sqlite backend
Existing stranded rendering for runs whose task files are still in the active listing is a must-not-regress
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: No changes to the human-review queue read or its reason vocabulary
No changes to the archive sweep itself
Do not modify or weaken assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A stop appended after a resolution marker is a fresh recurrence and must surface again
A resolved strand stays cleared even when its task file is absent (the infrared id-14/15 shape: archived phase, serviced strand)
Visibility must not depend on which phase the task sat in or whether siblings archived -- the exact accident-of-phase-composition defect the criterion names
